headline: Six Fronts Swap Bases as Casualties Mount
war_summary: On day 359 the war remains a patchwork of Colonial‑held western regions and Warden‑held northern sectors, but the last three hours have sharpened the churn on a half‑dozen fronts. Weathered Expanse now records 32 ownership changes in 24 hours — up from 36 in the prior edition — with Colonial casualties at 182,053 and Warden casualties at 200,014; both casualty rates and enlistments are accelerating. Mooring County has surged to 23 flips, three in the past two hours, pushing its 24‑hour toll to 25,444 Colonial and 21,272 Warden dead, while enlistments climb sharply. Stonecradle remains a flashpoint with 17 flips centred on World’s End, The Reach and Buckler Sound, totals 61,448 Colonial and 78,396 Warden. Farranac Coast holds steady at 12 flips, losses 49,063 Colonial and 61,130 Warden. Fishermans Row, quiet in the last report, now shows 12 flips across Black Well, Arcadia, Eidolo and Dankana Post, bringing its toll to 11,557 Colonial and 13,891 Warden. Linn Mercy eases to six flips around Lathair, 54,743 Colonial and 69,125 Warden. Stlican Shelf adds five flips near Fort Hoarfrost, 58,249 Colonial and 65,206 Warden. Northern Warden‑held sectors and rear areas show no ownership changes.
